ability.battlegroundsmod.destruction_god: Hold to charge a ringed energy sphere over your hand. Let go to throw it homing at the target; with no target it follows your aim until it finds someone and blows up everything around.
Freezes the target, flicks it up into the air, vanishes and reappears behind it for a slap that drives it back into the ground.

Point at the target and hold to keep a tiny sphere of destruction at your finger. Let go: it flies straight along your aim, implodes into a giant sun and keeps going until it hits. The explosion rises in smoke, rewinds and blows up again with a shockwave.
Erases from existence anyone under 20% health. Above that, summons a Hakai ball that chases the target, traps it and explodes.
Rises into the sky and drops a tiny white ball. The ground cracks into lava and bursts into plasma, pulverizing everything in a colossal radius.
Rises into the air, intangible, and fires a rain of energy spheres from the whole body at the target, then glides down. A strong stun cancels it.

Takes the target to space, where it drifts helplessly while Bills charges a sphere of destruction between his hands and throws it. The sphere carries the target back down to Earth from high in the sky and blows up in flames on impact.
A tiny spark that flies straight and pulverizes everything it touches, even other powers' attacks. Anyone under 20% health is disintegrated.
Breathes a stream of fire, burning and slowing everyone in the cone.
The Mangekyo eyes catch whoever is in front: stuns, blinds and seals the target's abilities for a few seconds.
Stands guard for a moment. Whoever strikes is grabbed by the Susanoo's arm, crushed and thrown.
Calls a giant meteor that tears through the clouds and falls on the target.
Rushes the target and grabs it by the neck in a cinematic strike.
Jumps, stops in the air and charges a fireball that grows while the key is held. Let go to throw it.
Records the next 30 seconds around you. Then rewrites fate: everything goes back to the start and whoever died is left a ghost.
The Susanoo's sword cuts a huge line ahead, splitting blocks and enemies.
Two meteors fall one after the other on the target.
gamerule.passivakokushibo.description: Off, Kokushibo (player and boss) gets no day/night buffs or debuffs and no Night Vision: weak regeneration and normal strength all the time.
gamerule.soulsBlockDestruction.descripti: When off, no skill or boss from the mod breaks or changes blocks. Effects and damage stay. mobGriefing off also stops it.
gamerule.soulsKokushiboImpact.descriptio: Kokushibo's awakened forms: impact frames, screen effects and slow motion. Off: as they were before (/soul effectsimpactkokushibo).
gamerule.soulbossfight.description: On: bosses have entrance and phase titles, boss bar, phases and the final ult. Off: they are plain mobs using all their moves from the start.
gamerule.soulbotscaoticos.description: On: bots and bosses drop their strategy and fight in chaos: much faster decisions, no waiting, almost random moves, short warnings, always running, random dodges, jumps, dashes and blinks. Cooldowns, stuns and human reaction stay the same.
power.battlegroundsmod.strongest.desc: Throughout heaven and earth, he alone is the honored one.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.0.des: Tap: a blue orb flies to where you aim, locks there and pulls enemies in for 6 s. Hold: it grows up to 5x in your hands and leaves only when you let go; then it follows your aim for 10 s (lagging slightly), pulling hard and tearing blocks out. While it is out, the mouse wheel sends it away (up to 70 blocks) or closer (down to 10); tap Z to park or unpark it; hold Z while it follows to shoot it so it explodes; hold Z while it is parked to make it circle you on its own (15 blocks) until it ends. Charged 50% or more, if it touches the ground its middle turns into a singularity that eats the blocks around it away (up to 10 blocks, faster the closer).
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.1.des: Repulsion: the red orb lights up at his fingertip and bursts into a wall of force straight where you aim, carving a cylindrical tunnel through ground and walls and throwing whoever is in it far away. Tap: the normal shot. Hold: it charges (past 50% its tails form) and fires only when you let go, much longer and wider.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.2.des: Hold C: the Red and the Blue appear behind you, come round to the front of your chest and slowly mix into the Purple (5 s). Keep holding: it grows up to 4x. Let go: it is launched straight where you aim, speeding up, and erases everything in its path (blocks and targets). Let go before it formed: it finishes forming and leaves at its base size. Unlimited Purple: park a fully charged Blue and hit it with a fully charged Red: both implode into a giant Purple that blows up in every direction over 100 blocks.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.3.des: Makes the hand sign and expands the domain: a black sphere swallows everything around. Inside there is only the void, and whoever is caught gets infinite information, paralyzed until the domain breaks.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.5.des: Hold out your hand: the Blue grabs the target you aim at (up to 50 blocks) and pulls it flying to you. Close to you time slows down and your fist cocks back crackling with black lightning. Always a Black Flash: the punch lands and holds, the target stuck on your fist while waves of black lightning burst out and open a crater at the punch point, and only then it is thrown far. Hold the key from the start to charge it.
message.battlegroundsmod.azul_flash_no_t: Aim at someone to pull them with the Blue.
message.battlegroundsmod.vermelho_no_tar: Aim at someone to appear behind them.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.6.des: Appears behind the target you aim at, floating upside down, raises the finger and fires the Red point blank.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.0.d: Hold to raise a box of black light around the target that grows while held. Let go and it shuts, lances pierce everyone inside and it shatters. With the Hogyoku active it is the full incantation: bigger and stronger.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.1.d: A clone of you stays in place while you turn invisible to everyone else and walk free for up to 7 seconds. Mobs go after the clone. Press again (or hit the clone) and it breaks like a mirror, and you show up wherever you are.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.2.d: Tap: a small pulse that drops whoever is near. Hold: the pressure grows to a huge radius, crushing everyone to the ground (no attacks, barely moving). Let go and it bursts.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.3.d: The Hogyoku lights up in your chest and a white cocoon closes around you (nothing can hurt you). It cracks and bursts, throwing everyone away, and you come out with six black butterfly wings: stronger, faster, the Black Box becomes the full incantation, and pressing V again does the dash of cuts.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.4.d: Raise one finger for half a second. Anyone who hits you in that time is stopped dead on it, time freezes and you draw the sword and cut back.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.6.d: A beam of white lightning that pierces everything in your aim.
message.battlegroundsmod.hogyoku: Hogyoku Evolution: press V again for the dash of cuts

power.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.desc: Low Soul from Bleach. Controlled blades: a thousand petals that cut whatever he wants.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.0.desc: The blade comes apart into a river of petal-blades that runs along your aim cutting everything in the way.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.1.desc: The petals close a sphere on the aimed target (or the closest one ahead) and crush it from every side. Never misses.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.2.desc: Flash step behind the target leaving an afterimage, then two cuts with a strong stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.3.desc: A thousand giant blades rise and become a storm of petals that follows you. Press V again: Senkei, rings of swords fence the target in. Shift+V: Shukei Hakuteiken.
power.battlegroundsmod.rukia.desc: Low Soul from Bleach. Zones of ice.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.0.desc: A white circle where you aim; a column of ice rises and everything inside turns into an ice statue.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.1.desc: A wide white avalanche forward that freezes everything in its way.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.2.desc: The blade stretches into ice at once and pierces far; the ice spreads from the wound.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.3.desc: You freeze over and turn white; absolute zero spreads around you and turns everyone close into crystal.
item.battlegroundsmod.soul_insect.tip1: Eat it once: you never go hungry again
item.battlegroundsmod.soul_insect.tip2: Hunger always full; out of combat mode it slowly heals your life (permanent passive)
message.battlegroundsmod.teleport_domain: Can't teleport into or out of a Domain Expansion
message.battlegroundsmod.soul_insect.eat: The Soul Insect lives in you now: you will never go hungry again

advancements.battlegroundsmod.soul_insec: Eat a Soul Insect and never go hungry again
power.battlegroundsmod.goku.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 6 (Continental). Pure ki: beams, teleport and the Kaioken, always past the limit.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.0.desc: Hold with cupped hands: the blue ball grows. Let go and the beam comes out; keep holding and it thickens, pushes the target and explodes at the end. With the Kaioken it comes out red and 2x bigger.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.1.desc: Fingers on the forehead for a moment: you vanish and appear behind the aimed target, already punching.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.2.desc: Red aura: punches 50% stronger and 1.5x faster, but your life drains (it never kills). Press again while it is on: a red blur of 4 hits and a launching kick.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.3.desc: Hands to the sky: the light of everything around gathers in a huge sphere. Hold up to 60 s (full, it kills in one hit) and let go: it falls slowly and leaves a crater.
power.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 6 (Continental). The proud prince: endless barrages and the Final Flash.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.0.desc: Hold: ki shots fly from both hands nonstop. The smoke piles up on the target and blinds it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.1.desc: The open palm forms a big ball of ki waves that flies straight and bursts into tongues of energy.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.2.desc: The strongest attack of the mod: he rises with the golden aura at its peak and blows up everything around (radius 12, deep crater). The price: 1 health left and turned to stone for 20 s (nothing gets through, but you can't act).
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.3.desc: Arms open gathering golden energy (you stand still and exposed), then the hands join and a giant beam goes through everything and tears the ground.
power.battlegroundsmod.freeza.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 6 (Continental). Elegant cruelty: piercing fingers, telekinesis and the Death Ball.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.0.desc: Point and hold: thin pink rays come from the finger, up to 6 in a row, piercing everyone in line.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.1.desc: Lifts the target and holds it (no skills). Press again: slams it into the ground, leaving a crater.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.2.desc: A pink saw disc grows on the finger and chases the target, turns and comes back, cutting you too if you don't dodge. Press again to pop it in the air.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.3.desc: An energy sphere grows on the raised finger until it is huge and falls slowly, exploding in a supernova.
power.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 7 (City). The strategist: a ray that pierces everything, a stretching arm and ki traps.
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.0.desc: Both hands over the head, a yellow ball crackling between them; the arms come down and a short, thick beam tears the ground it runs over, pushes the target and blows up on it in a big blast (crater and dust ring).
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.1.desc: The arm (with your skin) stretches 17 blocks, grabs the target and pulls it straight into a knee that launches and stuns it (hitstop and impact frame). Combo: X, then C.
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.2.desc: Only on a stunned target (e.g. right after the X). Piccolo vanishes and shows up around the target, kept stunned while he throws 20 ki balls that seem to miss and stop in the air (touching one hurts). Press again (or wait 4 s) and they all dive into it and blow up together.
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.3.desc: He throws off the heavy cape, turban and pads (they crack the ground), then holds two fingers on the forehead. Let go: a thin ray with two spirals pierces everyone in line up to 68 blocks and blows up far away (more charge, more damage).
power.battlegroundsmod.kame.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 7 (City). The old master: looks weak and silly, but wears anyone out.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.0.desc: He staggers in and every stumble is a blow (two crooked punches, a spin, a low sweep and both palms). For 4 s, 60% of the melee hits slip past him and he slaps back. Press again: the palm at once.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.1.desc: You swell: body 1.4x bigger, shirt bursting, blue aura, punches +40%. Press again (or wait 3 s): the Kamehameha Max, and you are skinny again.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.2.desc: Two blue lightning bolts from the hands hold the target shaking for 2.5 s, then a burst knocks it down, stunned (time for the Mafuba).
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.3.desc: Only on a stunned target (e.g. right after the C). A green gale and tornado lift the target spinning, the wind runs into the jar with it shrinking inside, the lid falls and the seal sticks. Sealed 6 s: with 20% of life or less it dies sealed; with more it breaks the jar and comes out with 15% less. Then you kneel with no stamina.
power.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 8 (Block). The weakest of the group, but the smartest: discs that cut everything and a blinding flash.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.0.desc: A thin saw disc with small teeth forms over the raised hand and flies flat, cutting whoever it hits (very high damage) and the blocks on its way: what stood on the cut slides off and falls. Hold until it forms: two discs.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.1.desc: A white flash from the head blinds whoever was looking at you: stunned 6 s, white screen, mobs lose their target. A hit FROM THE FRONT wakes them at once; from behind, it doesn't.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.2.desc: The ball shoots up very fast, hangs high over the aimed spot and splits into 14 thin rays that rain on the enemies and the ground around them (a small blast and a hole each).
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.3.desc: A bigger disc (34 teeth). Thrown, hold the key to guide it with your finger: it curves toward where you look, cutting one target after another and whatever stands in its way.

message.battlegroundsmod.kame.shock_no_t: Bankoku Bikkuri Sho: aim at someone within %s blocks.
message.battlegroundsmod.kame.palm_no_ta: Palm: nobody close in front of you.

message.battlegroundsmod.kame.mafuba_nee: Mafuba: the target must be stunned (use the Bankoku Bikkuri Sho first).
message.battlegroundsmod.kame.sealed: You were sealed in the Mafuba jar!
message.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.taiyoke: Solar Flare: nobody was looking at you.
power.battlegroundsmod.naruto.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 6 (Continental). Loud and stubborn: clones everywhere, a Rasengan to the face and Sage Mode.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.0.desc: The chakra sphere forms in your palm, you run up to 18 blocks and drive it into the target: it grinds for half a second and launches them spinning like a drill. With clones alive it becomes the Oodama Rasengan (twice as big).
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.1.desc: Cross seal: three clones with 1 health appear in smoke and fight on their own. Press again: swap places with the clone closest to the target and punch from behind.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.2.desc: Four clones appear around the target and kick it up (U, ZU, MA, KI); you jump over it and come down heel first, slamming it into the ground.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.3.desc: You sit and meditate for 4 s (a hit breaks it). For 30 s every punch reaches 2 blocks farther and hits harder (Kawazu Kumite). Press again: the Rasenshuriken, thrown; at the target it becomes a giant sphere of wind needles that tears up the ground.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.4.desc: Cross seal: a clone goes out in smoke where you aim (16 blocks) and turns into a rock. It waits up to 45 s; when an enemy passes by, the rock bursts into smoke, Naruto comes out behind them and drives in a Rasengan. 2 armed at most. Tip: the rock breathes a little.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.9.desc: Shift+B: the clone turns into a Fuuma Shuriken and you throw it (32 blocks). If the enemy dodges, it turns into Naruto behind them and hits the Rasengan. If not, the cut, then the Rasengan right away.
power.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 6 (Continental). Cold and precise: burns with the Katon, reads the enemy's attack, paralyzes and runs them through with the Chidori.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.0.desc: Tiger seal, you breathe in and blow: a fireball swells at your mouth and flies (up to 44 blocks) straight at whoever is in your aim. It blows up 4 blocks round: stuns (in full even on a boss at its core), sets on fire, throws back and digs a small crater. The wind-up is short (under 1 s) and only a real stun cuts it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.1.desc: Hold: your hand becomes a chirping bundle of lightning scratching the ground (you can walk while charging). The longer you hold, the farther you go (8 to 22 blocks). Release: you run to the enemy in your aim, through them, tearing up the ground; nothing hits you during the dash. A target paralyzed or read by the Sharingan can't escape: critical hit.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.2.desc: A fast fan of 9 lightning needles (60°, 14 blocks). Whoever takes 2 or more is paralyzed for 3.5 s, sparks crawling over them, in full even on a boss; 1 needle stuns for 1.5 s.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.3.desc: A quick seal (under 1 s) and the storm is called over the target (up to 64 blocks): you're free to fight while the clouds gather, and a dragon of lightning comes down on it. It can't be dodged (it follows the target). An 8-block storm of lightning, bolts running along the ground and a deep crater. Open sky only.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.4.desc: The Sharingan stays on for 6 s. The first 2 blows that would hit you (punch, shot or skill) miss: you slide to the free side and the blow goes through an afterimage. On the 2nd you appear behind the attacker with a spinning kick. Whoever you read is marked for 4 s: the Chidori goes straight at them for a critical hit, and a single Senbon needle paralyzes. A blow too strong (a Divine Soul's ult) gets through.
power.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 7 (City). The ninja who copied a thousand techniques: a lightning hound, Kamui and the copying Sharingan.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.0.desc: The left hand holds the wrist and the Raikiri grows in steps; you rush up to 16 blocks opening a lit furrow and throw the target. HOLD Z: Raiju Tsuiga, you drive the hand into the ground and the lightning becomes a hound that chases the target along the ground (turns if it dodges, up to 24 blocks) and bites: 2 s of paralysis.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.1.desc: The Mangekyo turns and the space around the target becomes a spiral: it is pulled into another dimension and is out of the fight for 4 s (can't hit, can't be hit), then spat back out, hurt. Shift+X: Kamui on yourself.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.2.desc: The last skill ANYONE used near you in the last 10 s (a Soul, a Low Soul or a boss) you use once, 20% stronger. A Divine Soul's ult can't be copied.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.3.desc: The samurai Susanoo rises from below with you at its head (nothing reaches you inside), a Kamui shuriken in each hand. It throws both where you aim: the space becomes a spiral, everything around is pulled in and hurt, whoever reaches the middle vanishes for a while and comes back thrown, and the ground is swallowed.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.4.desc: Trap: you slam the scroll and plant a blood seal where you aim (up to 16 blocks), armed for 40 s. Whoever steps on it makes 8 hounds burst from the ground and bite arms, legs and body: held 2.5 s, no moving, no skills. Goes well with the Raikiri.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.6.desc: Shift+X: your body goes into the Kamui for a little over 1 s: intangible, the blow goes through.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.8.desc: They say Kakashi keeps a forbidden technique. No one who took it talks about it.
power.battlegroundsmod.gaara.desc: SubSoul of Naruto, Tier 7 (City). Real sand: it guards you on its own, grabs, crushes, carries you through the air and swallows a whole area.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.0.desc: The sand springs from the ground 3 blocks ahead into a giant hand (jointed fingers and a thumb) that runs low along the ground to the target (up to 18 blocks) and slaps it away, tearing the ground. HOLD Z: the fingers close on the target and the hand becomes the Sand Coffin. Passive, Sand Shield: the first hit or shot from the front every 6 s sticks in a wall of sand.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.1.desc: The sand runs along the ground to the target (up to 24 blocks), climbs the legs and covers the whole body in a shell: held 3 s, no walking, no skills. Press again: Sabaku Soso, the sand squeezes at once and bursts. With someone sinking in your Quicksand, X takes them from any distance.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.2.desc: A thick platform of sand under your feet and you fly free and fast, like the creative flight: aim = way, Space up, Shift down, sprint = burst. It burns stamina while you fly (faster = more); out of stamina it crumbles and you float down. Press again: land.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.3.desc: Ult. You raise your hands and the aimed area (radius 10 blocks, up to 30 away) turns into turning quicksand: nobody inside can leave. A ring wave of sand rises as tall as a building, curls in, closes into a dome and falls: huge damage, a stun, and the area buried in a crater.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.4.desc: Trap: you touch the ground and the sand runs under it to where you aim (up to 20 blocks); the ground becomes an almost hidden spiral of sand, armed 40 s (two at a time). Whoever steps in sinks to the waist: very slow, no jumping, pulled to the middle for 4 s. Combos with X.
power.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.desc: Naruto SubSoul, Tier 8 (Block). Lazy genius: his shadows hold on stamina and the paper bombs become his board. Whoever thinks wins.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.0.des: Your shadow runs along the ground to the target (24 blocks) and catches it, bosses too: it copies every step you take. No fixed time: it holds while you have stamina, draining per second 20% on a stronger target (~5 s), 10% on the same tier (~10 s) and 5% on a weaker one (~20 s). At zero it lets go and you are Exhausted. Press again and hold: Shadow Neck Bind, damage while held (drains 1.5x). Letting go of the key frees the target.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.1.des: The shadow splits toward up to 4 enemies (20 blocks) and rises in a needle into each: pierces and pins them while your stamina lasts (each target adds up). Press again to let go.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.2.des: Only throws: a tap throws 1 paper where you aim (22 blocks); holding opens a fan of up to 10 at once. Up to 10 armed; 10 in the pouch, 1 back every 3 s; they vanish after 60 s. One goes off when an enemy steps on it and lights its neighbours in a chain. Shift+C sets them all off. The strategy is yours: lay out the field and walk the target in with Shadow Possession. Held by the shadow through 4 or more blasts: the pit, stunned 3 s.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.3.des: Kneels and thinks for 1 s (hard to crush), the shadow floods 16 blocks around and catches everyone. A paper bomb rises from each one's feet and they go off in a chain, nearest first.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.4.des: Fires a flare behind you: for 8 s the light stretches the shadows, Shadow Possession and Shadow Stitching reach twice as far and drain half the stamina. 40 s recharge.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.7.des: Shift+C: every armed paper bomb goes off, nearest first.
power.battlegroundsmod.ino.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 8 (Block). The mind is the weapon: you drive the enemy's body, scramble his head and tie everyone's pain together. Passive, Mind Reading: when an enemy within 16 blocks starts a skill, a purple diamond pulses over his head and a thread ties your forehead to his (only you see it). Time to dodge.
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.0.desc: Diamond seal: your body drops and the spirit flies straight along the ground, up to 20 blocks (it can be dodged). Caught: YOU drive his body (WASD walks, click hits, space jumps) for 10 s on someone weaker, 7 s on the same tier, 5 s on someone stronger and 4 s on a boss. Press again: Exit, the body you leave hurts itself. Your body lies there defenseless: a hit on it brings the spirit back and you are dizzy 1 s (a miss too). A target marked by the pollen (B): the spirit chases him.
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.1.desc: A purple wave from your forehead (a 12-block cone). Players caught get their controls inverted (walking and looking) for 7 s (3 s on a boss); mobs attack whoever is closest.
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.2.desc: Purple threads from your forehead tie the minds of up to 3 enemies: for 6 s half the damage one takes runs along the thread to the others. A thread snaps past 12 blocks.
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.3.desc: She kneels and makes the seal: her mind covers 20 blocks (a dome, the sky turns into her mind). Everyone inside gets puppet strings and they beat each other for 10 s (5 s on a boss); then the strings pull everyone up and each mind bursts (high damage and a 2 s stun). A strong hit on her ends the play.
message.battlegroundsmod.ino.body_hit: Mind Transfer: your body was hit, the spirit came back!
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.4.desc: Throws seeds where you aim (up to 20 blocks): a bed of flowers grows (2.5 blocks, 30 s, 2 at most). Whoever steps in is covered in pollen and marked 8 s: your next Mind Transfer chases him.
message.battlegroundsmod.naruto.rendan_n: Uzumaki Combo: needs a target nearby.
message.battlegroundsmod.naruto.sage_bro: Sage Mode: your meditation was broken!
message.battlegroundsmod.naruto.fuuma_mi: Fuuma Shuriken: it hit no one.
message.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.nothing_: Sharingan: nobody attacked, nothing to read.
message.battlegroundsmod.gaara.grab_miss: Sand Hand: it didn't grab anyone.
message.battlegroundsmod.gaara.no_target: Sand Coffin: no target in sight.
message.battlegroundsmod.gaara.platform_: Sand Platform: out of stamina, the sand crumbles.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.no_ta: Shadow Possession: no target within the shadow's reach.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.escap: Shadow Possession: the target escaped the shadow.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.held: Shadow: that target is already held by another technique.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.out_o: Shadow: out of stamina, the shadow let go.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.no_ta: Paper bomb: the pouch is empty (1 back every %s s).
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.no_ar: Paper bomb: no armed paper to set off.
message.battlegroundsmod.ino.wave_miss: Mind Disturbance: nobody was caught by the wave.
message.battlegroundsmod.ino.link_few: Mind Link: needs at least 2 enemies nearby.
power.battlegroundsmod.itadori.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 6 (Continental). The strongest body of the SubAlmas. Passive Monstrous Body: base punches 15% stronger, and every blow you land fills your Rhythm (it drains after 5 s without hitting): the more Rhythm, the wider the Black Flash window.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.0.desc: Three fast punches (the first steps in); the third carries the delayed cursed energy, which lands again a moment later and comes out of the back. Hold Z to keep the delay stored on the target and let go to set it off wherever they went. Weaker on a guard, but it breaks it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.1.desc: A ring closes on your fist: press again right when it closes and the blow becomes a Black Flash: black lightning, a lot of damage. The window grows with your Rhythm. Then you are in the zone for 5 s: the window doubles and you can chain up to 4 (the 4th sinks the ground).
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.2.desc: You guard for 1 s: a blow from the front is caught and answered with a high kick, and a shot from the front is kicked back at whoever threw it. Nobody struck: the cooldown comes back sooner.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.3.desc: Your palm touches something and a dashed "cut here" line with scissors goes round it. Press V on up to 3 things (an enemy, a pillar, a wall); V again closes every pair of scissors at once, or they close by themselves 3 s after the last mark. Pillars fall, enemies are cut.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.4.desc: A punch to the soul. On someone using or charging a power, the soul is knocked out for a moment: the move is cut and they have no power for 3 s. On someone doing nothing, it is just a punch (and the cooldown is shorter).
power.battlegroundsmod.choso.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 6 (Continental). Real Blood Manipulation: the piercing line, the orbs, the binding, Maximum Piercing and the Meteorite. Every blow of blood that lands leaves a pool on the ground for 10 s: a trap for the Supernova and the Meteorite.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.0.desc: Hold to compress the blood between your palms (up to 2 s) and let go: a thin line too fast to see, 25 blocks through everyone. The longer the hold, the harder and the longer it pours, and you sweep it with your aim while it does.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.1.desc: 5 orbs of blood circle you: each one takes a hit or a shot and bursts. Press again (or after 8 s) and the ones left burst into needles, along with every pool of yours near by.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.2.desc: A rope of blood flies 12 blocks and binds whoever it meets for 2.5 s (no walking, no skills). Press again: you pull them to your feet and slam them down.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.3.desc: The mark on your face lights up and your blood leaves the body, spiralling into your palms for 2 s (you hold firm). A giant Piercing Blood goes 40 blocks, cutting the ground in a sweeping fan, and at the end the whole trail bursts into blood spikes.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.4.desc: A ball of hardened blood thrown in an arc that crushes where it lands, leaving a crater. Landing near one of your pools bursts the pool into needles.
power.battlegroundsmod.nanami.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 7 (City). The Ratio Technique: the 7:3 point of anything becomes a critical hit. On the clock: after 1 minute of fighting, every hit of his lands 20% harder.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.0.desc: Nanami measures the target: a ruler with the 7:3 point shows on its chest (3 s). Press again and he steps in and strikes the point: a critical with double damage and 2 s of stun (2 s on a boss of the same tier or weaker too; stronger, less). Any hit of yours on the marked point counts.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.1.desc: Nanami drives his fist into the 7:3 point of the wall or ground he is looking at: cracks run and it all comes down, with a crater and flying blocks. Whoever is near takes the damage and is thrown.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.2.desc: Three fast cuts with the wrapped cleaver, each on the 7:3 point: three criticals in a row. The second breaks guard and the last stuns for 2 s and pushes.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.3.desc: Nanami wraps his tie round his fist, leaps and sinks the whole area with one punch: a big crater and everyone around pinned to the ground. Then 12 s of Overtime with more strength.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.4.desc: Guard stance for 1 s. If someone hits him in that time, the blow does not land and he answers on the 7:3 point: a critical with 2 s of stun.
power.battlegroundsmod.nobara.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 8 (Block). Straw Doll Technique: every nail carries cursed energy. Passive Nail In: a nail stays in someone 10 s (up to 3), and Hairpin and Resonance hit harder for each one. One of the mod's biggest stunners.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.0.desc: You toss 3 nails up and hammer all three at once: they fly up to 25 blocks wrapped in cursed energy and stick (in someone or in a wall, 10 s). Press again (Hairpin): every stuck nail bursts and stuns for real (25 ticks).
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.1.desc: You hammer the straw doll: everyone with your nail in them or your blood, up to 60 blocks away, is torn from the inside by thorns of black energy. Heavy damage (more per nail) and 2 s of stun, full on bosses of your tier. It costs a little of your blood.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.2.desc: Right on the target: you set the nail on their chest and hammer it. The nail stays, their blood is yours for the Resonance, they are pushed back and stunned 1.5 s.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.3.desc: You drive a nail into your own palm. For 8 s a red thread ties you to everyone with your nail or blood, and every hit you take comes back to them doubled. At the end, the hammer again: a giant Resonance on all of them and 3 s of stun. Risky: you bleed to use it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.4.desc: You crouch and drive 7 nails into the ground in a fan (traps, 20 s). Whoever steps by one takes it in the foot: then follow up with Hairpin (Z) or Resonance (X).
power.battlegroundsmod.todo.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 6 (Continental). Boogie Woogie: one clap and everything swaps places. Whoever he swaps is lost for a moment: the next hit on them is a critical.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.0.desc: Tap: a clap and you swap places with whoever you aim at (up to 25 blocks). Hold: marks who you aimed at; let go aiming at someone else and the two swap (letting go at nothing, you swap with the marked one).
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.1.desc: You rip a block out of the ground and throw it over the target; a clap swaps you with the block, and you come down from above with a hammer punch.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.2.desc: You clap without the technique. Mobs fall for it and turn round for 1 s; everyone near is left open: the next hit on them is a critical.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.3.desc: You stamp and kick 11 blocks up round the target. Then 12 claps in 2 s: each one swaps the target with a block in the air and you are there hitting (punch or kick). On the last they land in front of you and you end with a Black Flash.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.4.desc: The metal hand. Hold: for up to 6 s you swap with no clap, no sound and no warning, several times a second, each swap with a blow from a new side. Now and then two enemies swap with each other.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.8.desc: Shift+V, full ult bar. Cursed energy bursts from your shoulders and you dash up to 50 blocks steered by your aim; nothing stops you. Touch someone: you stop dead and the punch is a Black Flash, always. Hit nobody and the ult is gone.
power.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 7 (City). Cursed Speech: the collar comes down, the snake mark lights up and every word is an order that truly stuns. Every word strains his throat; past the limit he coughs blood and can't speak for 4 s.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.0.desc: Whoever you look at (15 blocks) freezes for 1.5 s, stunned (a boss of your tier too; a stronger one a little less). Holding Z keeps the order up to 3 s more, but the throat fills fast.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.1.desc: An unseen weight comes down from above on the target: heavy damage, the ground gives way in the shape of the body and it is pinned and stunned. A critical on a target stopped by "Stop" (asleep too). Strains the throat a lot.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.2.desc: Whoever you look at (8 blocks) sleeps for 3 s, stunned, or until hit; that hit is a critical.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.3.desc: He breathes in and shouts with everything: the wave goes out in a 30-block cone, rips the ground up and throws everyone far with heavy damage. The throat bursts on the spot (coughing blood, 4 s silent) unless it was empty before.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.4.desc: He takes out the megaphone (6 s): the next word (Z, X or C) takes everyone in a 25-block cone instead of one target, and strains the throat 1.5x more.
power.battlegroundsmod.miwa.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 8 (Block). New Shadow Style: the swordswoman of patience and the counter. Calm Sheath: every second without attacking fills 1 of 3 marks (+25% each), spent by the next cut.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.0.desc: Hold the stance and let go: the sword is out and back in 1 tick, and the cut only opens on the target a moment later (up to 3.4 blocks). Letting go on the scabbard's click (the glint, 1 s) is the Perfect Batto: double damage, 1.5 s of stun, and it cuts the stone beside you too.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.1.desc: The circle on the ground: whoever steps in is cut on their own and thrown out, shots that come in are cut down, and a Domain Expansion has no hold on you inside it. Each automatic cut fills 1 Calm Sheath mark. Press again, or step out of it, to undo it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.2.desc: You cross 8 blocks in an instant through the target and leave a slit in the ground. Only after you sheathe (the click) does the cut open on them, with a stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.3.desc: Eyes shut: the Simple Domain grows to 8 blocks for 5 s, and everyone who comes in is marked. At the end, or pressing V again, one single draw cuts everyone marked at once and the ground inside the circle: 3 s of stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.4.desc: You sheathe and open a 0.8 s window. If someone hits you in it, the blow vanishes and you appear behind the attacker already cutting: 2 s of stun. If nobody hits, you are open for a moment.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.miss: Nobody in reach of the blow.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.bf_earl: Too early! The ring had not closed yet.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.bf_late: Too late! The ring had already closed.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.zone: In the zone! Black Flash %s of 4.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.alma: Soul knocked out! No power for %s s.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.alma_va: They were not using any power: just a punch.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.tesoura: Nothing in reach of your palm to mark.
message.battlegroundsmod.nanami.miss: Nobody in reach of the blade.
message.battlegroundsmod.nanami.not_yet: Still on the clock: %s s of fighting left before Overtime.
message.battlegroundsmod.nobara.no_link: Nobody with your nail or your blood for the Resonance.
message.battlegroundsmod.nobara.too_far: You need to be right on the target.
message.battlegroundsmod.todo.no_target: Aim at someone to swap places.
message.battlegroundsmod.todo.nobody: Nobody near to fall for the fake clap.
message.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.silence: The throat gave out: no speaking for 4 s.
message.battlegroundsmod.miwa.marks: Calm Sheath: %s marks in the cut.
power.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.desc: Upper Moon One. Every cut of Moon Breathing fills the air with moons. Oni: strong regeneration (swords and destruction stop it for 5 s), 1.5x stronger at night, more at the full moon, weaker and slower to heal under the sun. The H key stretches the sword: Z, X, C, B and V become the 7th, 8th, 9th, 10th and 14th Forms, and Shift+V the 16th. Every cut and every moon lands as a blow of its own.
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.0.de: A Moon Breathing quick draw: a giant crescent slash opens in front of you, cream outside and ember inside, throwing out chains of crescent moons that glow and break into flakes of light. Cuts everything inside the arc.
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.1.de: He leaps and three cuts loop around him in tilted planes, like a closing flower, turning to guard him while they throw a barrage of crescent moons outwards. Anyone who comes close is cut and thrown out. Counter: works while being beaten up (punches and combos), but not out of a technique's stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.2.de: Two gigantic crescent cuts low over the ground, one swung out and one back, throwing a storm of moons over the area. Tears the ground in arcs where the cuts pass.
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.3.de: A storm of dozens of crescent blades, small to gigantic, thrown in one burst ahead, each on its own curved path. Leaves no room to escape and destroys everything it passes.
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.4.de: Without swinging, seven curved cuts stacked one over the other become a hurricane around him that never stops turning. A defense: anyone who tries to come close is cut and thrown out, and the ground is torn in a spiral. Counter: works while being beaten up (punches and combos), but not out of a technique's stun.
message.battlegroundsmod.vazio_relampago: No one close enough for the 0.2-second Domain Expansion.
The 0.2-second Domain Expansion does nothing inside or against a Domain: only your real Expansion (V) holds off the Shrine.
Caught charging! 0.2-second Domain Expansion: brain damage and out of stamina.
0.2-second Domain Expansion: technique broken, brain damage.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.8.des: Counter: the Domain's hand sign in a blink, the Void opens for an instant and closes in an X across the screen. Breaks any technique of everyone in the Domain's reach (charging, halfway or active, attacks in the air, even a Domain opening). Everyone takes Brain Damage and is locked in place: 3 s for bosses and mobs, 5 s for players, +1 s for each tier the target is below you. Whoever was charging or using a technique also loses all stamina. With no one near it does not go off.
fala.battlegroundsmod.gojo.fugindo: Where do you think you're going?
fala.battlegroundsmod.bills.atordoado: Hold still. This will be quick.
fala.battlegroundsmod.bills.fome: I'm getting hungry... let's finish this.
fala.battlegroundsmod.bills.pouca_vida: Now you've really made me angry...
fala.battlegroundsmod.bills.inevitavel: Do you really think you can face me with that level of power? Pathetic.
fala.battlegroundsmod.bills.inevitavel_f: Know this: the God of Destruction is inevitable.
fala.battlegroundsmod.aizen.kyoka: Since when were you under the impression I was there?
fala.battlegroundsmod.aizen.dedo: Don't use such strong words, it makes you look weak.
fala.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.fuga: Arm yourself. Use your best move to defend against this.
fala.battlegroundsmod.aizen.hogyoku: No one stands at the top from the start.
message.battlegroundsmod.moon_sword.off: The sword is back to normal
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.8.de: Only with the sword stretched (H). Six giant crescent cuts fall from the sky, homing on anyone within 50 blocks, no aiming: one per enemy, and a lone enemy takes all six on the head, one every 0.5 s. Each one leaves a crater. With the normal sword, Shift+V uses the 6th.
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.desperta: All you did... was tear my kimono off.
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.pouca_vi: What a hideous form... is this?
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.bebe: Not even an infant would die from that...
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.dois: If I kill the two of you... everyone else will be defeated easily.
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.dificil: I must admit... your movements are hard to read.
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.trezento: I haven't seen anyone like you in 300 years...
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.inicio: I shall draw my sword... it would be rude of me not to.
power.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.desc: Ryomen Sukuna, the King of Curses. His techniques arrive one by one: Dismantle on Z (combo, chant and the World Cutting Slash), cuts on the opponent on Shift+Z, Cleave on X, Fuga on C, the Domain Expansion (Malevolent Shrine) on V and the Slam on B.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.0.desc: Tap: the crescent flies from the hand, white-hot then black with a white outline, cuts through whoever is in its plane and breaks into pieces. A 3-tap combo (each tap opens 1 s for the next): standing, lying and a burst of 6 cuts that throws far. Hold: the chant, a word every half second; letting go fires at the stage reached: 1 Dragon Scales 1.75x, 2 Recoil 2.5x, 3 Paired Falling Stars (two crescents in an X) 3.5x. Getting hit breaks the chant. With the Model bar full (fills slowly as cuts land, much faster when they hit a defense), after the 3rd word he joins his hands: the 4th stage, the World Cutting Slash, ignores every defense. Standing: one giant thin crescent that cuts everything in its plane and opens a slit through the blocks far ahead. Crouched: a grid of cuts (waffle) with a shorter reach. Empties the bar; getting hit during the gesture halves it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.1.desc: He sprints (~30 blocks). If he reaches the target he grabs it by the neck with one hand and lifts it: the camera stays free, he turns with it carrying the hanging target, and the throw goes wherever he faces. Fine cuts run through the body one by one, each at its own angle, until it snaps: the body turns into a black silhouette under the cuts, each cut shoots out of the body as a long stroke, with sparks, dark smoke and a mist of blood. The blow scales with the target's max health; he winds the arm back and throws it far. Against a wall: he pins the target to it and the cuts go on through the wall, opening a hole the target flies through. Lethal: the body comes apart into pieces that crumble and vanish over a pool of blood. A sprint that reaches no one brakes and says so.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.2.desc: "Open." Everything within 70 blocks goes dark. Ribbons of fire whip out of his hands and circle him, are sucked one by one into the fireball between his palms, which stretches into the arrow. He draws it like a bow, holds and looses: the arrow flies straight at the target, faster and faster, and bursts into a dome of fire that climbs into a column, burning and throwing everyone around. Needs a stunned target (caught from far away, up to 64 blocks): it is held in place for the whole charge (it can turn, not walk), Sukuna tells it to arm itself and it answers "!?". A 20-block blast, and everyone within 28 blocks catches fire; whoever dies to the Fuga turns to ash. Rooted while it forms.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.3.desc: "Domain Expansion: Malevolent Shrine." A wave runs out of him and stops every attack in the air within 40 blocks; whoever it reaches is paralyzed (with stamina, you resist). If it catches someone, the cutscene plays: the ground turns to water, a drop falls, everyone drowns in the red sea, the black aura and the six eyes, and the Shrine lights up behind him. Then everyone moves freely for 30 s: the Dismantle cuts all over stun each one a little, and Cleave hits everyone but him until it ends. V again closes it. V twice: opens fast, no cutscene.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.4.desc: He sprints (~24 blocks) and, if he reaches the target, throws an uppercut on the run that launches it up and forward. The punch carries Sukuna into a jump over its arc: he catches it by the neck up high, pulls it over his head and slams it into the ground (the body bounces and slides onto its back). The throw kicks him up and he lands standing on the target. The stomp spreads a web of cuts over the ground in three stages, each wider (up to ~13 blocks), cutting everyone around; then the whole web cuts the ground, four huge cuts cross it all and the ground blows up in the web's shape (with block destruction on, the world's own blocks are cut along the web's lines), throwing everyone up. The camera stays free the whole move. Missing the sprint = he stops and warns.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.5.desc: He throws nothing: he opens his hand towards the opponent (up to 24 blocks) and 20 cuts appear right on their body, one after another, in every direction, of very different sizes, some bending into a second stroke. Each one jolts and briefly stuns; the last throws far. He stands still while cutting.
fala.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.canto3: 番いの流星 Paired Falling Stars
fala.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.inicio_gojo: You're just a fish on my cutting board...
fala.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.matou_gojo: You were magnificent. I will never forget you as long as I live.

message.battlegroundsmod.wish.alma.desc: The soul of a Dragon Ball character you already beat in the arena
message.battlegroundsmod.wish.rival.desc: The next character of the book comes down to fight you right here
message.battlegroundsmod.wish.imortal.de: 10 minutes of regeneration and resistance, and dying takes no Poder
message.battlegroundsmod.wish_none: There is no wish to make.
message.battlegroundsmod.shenlong_done: Shenron: Your wish has been granted. Farewell!
message.battlegroundsmod.flight_tired: No energy to fly: eat something.
message.battlegroundsmod.flight_tired_st: Out of breath: gliding down to land. Standing still in the air or on the ground brings it back.
npc.battlegroundsmod.gohan.weak: Want to learn to fly? Get a little stronger first. Come back at Tier 9.
npc.battlegroundsmod.gohan.teach: Gather your ki under your body and let it out slowly... That's it! Jump twice and you fly. Careful: flying makes you hungry.
npc.battlegroundsmod.gohan.after.0: Flying is tiring. Bring food, or a Senzu.
npc.battlegroundsmod.gohan.after.1: Master Korin gives a Senzu a day. Don't forget to visit him.
npc.battlegroundsmod.gohan.after.2: Saibamen look weak, but they come in packs.
npc.battlegroundsmod.korin.senzu: Here, a Senzu Bean. Come back tomorrow for another.
npc.battlegroundsmod.korin.hint.0: I already gave you today's Senzu. Come back tomorrow.

power.battlegroundsmod.makima.desc: Makima, the Control Devil. Not strong or destructive: she controls, manipulates and makes others fight for her. Bang on Z, Chain on X, Order on Shift+X, Puppet on C, Rats on Shift+C, the Souls on V and the Ritual of Names on B. Passive Prime Minister: a blow that would kill her goes to a mob within 200 blocks (her puppets first).
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.0.desc: Index and thumb up: "Bang." The air ripples along the finger's line, a shock shell on the body, red mist, the body thrown back folding over itself, a short manga impact frame and BANG in big letters by her hand. Tap: the one she points at, 0.55 s later. Hold: her eyes lock one target at a time (rings round each), up to 3; letting go shoots them one after the other. Anyone at 15% life or less is blown apart.
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.1.desc: A chain flies from her hand, forged link by link, wraps the target's chest and holds them kneeling while red pulses run from them to her hand: stunned and drained of stamina. Missed = a warning.
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.2.desc: Every mob she kills is pulled to her by a chain and sinks into her shadow: kept (up to 9). C lets one out: a dark pool opens beside her and it comes up jerkily, pulled by the nape, a chain from her back to it and her rings in its eyes; then it fights for her. Up to 3 out at once. Holding C opens her panel: the outer ring holds the ones kept (a click picks, letting go of C brings them up); the inner ring holds the ones out, puppets and V souls (a click calls one back into her shadow, the right button gives orders: attack her target, follow, stay, fight freely, let go); the middle calls them all back or sends them all at the target.
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.3.desc: The souls she has killed (a Gojo, a Sukuna, a player who had a soul) come up out of a dark ground, chains first and the body pulled jerkily after, bound at the chest and arms, a chain from her back to each: up to 2, fighting with their own kit for 40 s. V again: "Die." and both execute their targets at the same moment, an impact frame, and they sink back (the soul goes back to her). Without souls: chains burst out of the ground on everyone around, each body bound at its neck, chest, arms and legs; V again: "Die." and they squeeze until the bodies burst.
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.4.desc: Opens a sheet of paper: she writes one name per puppet she has out (ditto marks repeat the line above), and the autocomplete only offers those she has seen (with her own eyes, through the rats or in a fight). She joins her hands and says the name, the world goes gray, the puppets behind her repeat it one after another and each one is crushed, and the target with it, up to 60 blocks away and through walls: one blow kneels them (25% of their life), two puts them on all fours (45%), three crushes them dead (a boss takes a heavy blow). Without puppets: signed with her own blood, 20% of her life, one blow. A name she doesn't know is struck out, warned about, and nothing is spent.
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.6.desc: She says one word and the one she looks at obeys, picked by how they stand: far, "Come." (walks to her stiffly like a puppet and kneels); near, "Kneel." (knees driven into the ground with a crack); near and beneath her, "Woof." (on all fours, answers "Woof!"); low on life, "Die." (the color leaves the world and they drop dead). When she speaks the world goes gray and her voice runs through the air; the target's eyes take her rings while it obeys.
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.7.desc: Her eyes in the rats: 8 rats around (some by the enemies she can't see), the world goes gray and dark in a vignette for her only, enemies show through walls as red ghosts and her yellow rings light over each rat from the nearest out. Shift+C again: she sinks into a pool of shadow (rats run out of it) and comes up jerkily beside the rat she looks at, facing the nearest enemy.

power.battlegroundsmod.shigaraki.desc: Tomura Shigaraki, heir of All For One. Whatever he touches with all five fingers dries, cracks and turns to dust, and the Decay spreads through whatever is touching it. Touch on Z, Sonic Scream on X, Hands from the Ground on C, Hand Tentacles on V, Absorb on B, Regeneration on Shift+Z and End of the World on Shift+V.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shigaraki.0.des: He dashes (up to 18 blocks) with an open hand and grabs the target by the face: impact frame, and the Decay runs from the touch through the whole body, which dries, cracks and falls apart. Whoever survives goes back to normal. Missed: the hand hits the ground and a living crack runs ahead, undoing the blocks.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shigaraki.1.des: He breathes in and screams: a 46-block cone of sound leaves his mouth, lifts the ground it passes, shatters glass and throws and stuns everyone ahead (longer close to him).
ability.battlegroundsmod.shigaraki.2.des: A slap on the ground leaves a hand print, and a crack runs to it. The print is a trap: whoever steps on it is grabbed by eight hands out of the earth that hold the target still (works on bosses). Combines with Touch and Tentacles.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shigaraki.3.des: The ult. Five tentacles made of hands burst from his back and sweep everything around for 9 seconds. Touched, dead: whoever they touch starts to come apart, and every spot they touch on the ground and on buildings becomes a seed of Decay that spreads. The camera stays free.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shigaraki.4.des: He sees everyone's power around him (each with its aura) and dashes for one: holds them by the head and drains the power through a cord of energy. For 15 s the stolen power is his: B again uses it (fire, lightning or ice, by its owner). The drained one stays weak for a while.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shigaraki.5.des: He stands still and the body remakes itself: fibers grow out of the wounds, the cuts stitch shut and the arm grows back. A strong heal that costs a lot of stamina; tired, it fails.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shigaraki.8.des: "Disappear." He kneels and touches the ground with all five fingers: the Decay runs out at 24 blocks a second to 150 blocks, climbing everything that stands, with a wall of dust at its front. Buildings, mountains and whoever is in the way turn to dust. Only the ground under him stays.
